invariants.rationale: dedupedRecords will be used in a stream, so it cannot be null.
partitioner is used for partitioning and must be non-null to call methods on it.
dedupedRecords is declared as a List; type compatibility is guaranteed.
partitioner must be of type Partitioner as declared.
All records in dedupedRecords are likely to be non-null to correctly perform partitioning and key extraction.
